items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, this is Priya Nandakumar from campus dining. Each term we hold a tasting night where students try new dishes and vote on which ones go on the menu. It's normally on a Thursday in the Corrick dining hall. This term the Corrick kitchen is being re-tiled, so our first plan was to move the event to the riverside café. But the café seats about forty people, and we usually get two hundred. Then we heard the tiling will be finished by Wednesday; the sealant just needs a full day to set before the kitchen can be used. So the tasting stays in the Corrick dining hall, and it moves to Friday, from 6 to 8. The doors are open to everyone, guests included, the food is free, and there's no need to sign up in advance. Bring your student card, though. We scan it when you vote, so each person's vote is counted only once.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Campus dining services] Why does the speaker say, "Bring your student card, though"?
choices: To explain how the votes on new dishes will be kept to one per person
To indicate that the dishes will be charged to the students' meal plans
To indicate that guests without a card will be turned away at the door
To explain how students should sign up in advance for the tasting

"To indicate that guests without a card will be turned away at the door" is contradicted by "The doors are open to everyone, guests included." "To explain how students should sign up in advance for the tasting" is contradicted by "there's no need to sign up in advance."
